name: What is the typical process for designing and building a custom gazebo with AKN Design Group?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for designing and building a custom gazebo with AKN Design Group?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our process for designing and building a custom gazebo begins with an initial consultation to understand your vision and functional needs for your high-end outdoor living space. Following this, our integrated design-build team develops CAD-supported layouts and material selections. We then manage all aspects from permit coordination to construction, ensuring seamless integration with your existing landscape and structures. This managed process from consultation to final walkthrough ensures clear communication and a single point of coordination, reflecting our commitment to professionalism and craftsmanship.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves an initial consultation, CAD-supported design, permit coordination, and comprehensive construction management, all handled by our integrated design-build team.
